notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance.
easyPrerequisites: You control eight or more lands.
description:
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing it to become prepared.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
